<div class="card-body">
'''Imperial Squad Leader''' is a [[Dark]] [[Character]] ([[Imperial]]) from [[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">帝国軍分隊指揮官</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">きっかり3人の兵員／トルーパーからなる“分隊”とともに移動する場合、1フォースで4人全員が移動できる。同じ位置カード上の兵員／トルーパーはそれぞれ没収値＋1。「帝国軍警備兵員」は分隊指揮官と一緒であれば移動可能となる（フォースは通常通り消費する）。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-ANH-Imperial-Squad-Leader-PSA-90960097.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">モッド・テリック大尉は、デザート・サンズ・サンドトルーパー部隊のごく典型的な士官である。勇敢で忠誠心が強い。必要とあらば、兵員たちを犠牲にすることも厭わない。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Imperial Squad Leader.

'''Card text:'''
When moving with a squad of exactly three personnel or troopers, all four may move for 1 Force. Personnel or troopers on the same location card are each forfeit +1. Imperial Trooper Guards can move if they are with the squad leader. Force is used as usual.

'''Lore:'''
Captain Mod Terrik is a very typical officer of the Desert Sands sandtrooper unit. He is brave and loyal. If necessary, he does not hesitate to sacrifice his troops.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Game text uses 兵員／トルーパー and 位置カード, does not say your troopers, and names Imperial Trooper Guards 「帝国軍警備兵員」.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Imperial Squad Leader]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
